## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
This PR adds `preview()`, which returns the first 200 characters of a file under a home directory, and `settings_file()`, which returns the path to the settings file. It also adds tests for both. `preview()` checks containment only on the path text, so a relative path containing `..` gets through and the function reads files outside home. Fix this before merging.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — `candidate.is_relative_to(Path(home))` only compares path text and never resolves `..` or symlinks. For example, `preview("/home/alice", "../../etc/passwd")` builds `/home/alice/../../etc/passwd`. That path still starts with `/home/alice`, so the check passes and `read_text()` opens `/etc/passwd`. A symlink inside home that points outside it is followed the same way. The only rejection test (tests/test_paths.py:20) uses an absolute path that `/` already replaces, so it doesn't catch this. Calling `.resolve()` on both paths before the check would fix it. — Anyone who controls `relative` can read the first 200 characters of any file the process can open. That defeats the "outside home" guard this function exists to provide.

## Strengths
- The tests cover the 200-character limit with a 500-character file, as well as the short-file case.
- `settings_file()` is simple, and its test checks the exact expected path.
